description:
Regional Sales Director – LATAM

Executive Leadership | Reports to the CEO

At VU Security, we work to improve the quality of life of citizens and organizations by building frictionless digital experiences. To achieve this, we combine traditional cybersecurity controls with biometrics, geolocation, machine learning, ID document recognition, and user behavior analysis.

Role Mission:

Lead VU’s commercial strategy and execution across Latin America, driving sustainable revenue growth, regional expansion, and business development.

The Regional Sales Director will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing sales organization, developing strategic customer relationships, and establishing a scalable and autonomous commercial operation.

The main challenge will be to ensure consistent growth while reducing the company's operational dependence on the CEO.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the regional commercial strategy, aligned with VU’s business objectives.

  • Own revenue growth, new business development, account expansion, and renewals.

  • Identify opportunities across new markets, industries, and strategic accounts.

  • Drive the commercialization of VU ONE, focusing on digital identity, authentication, and fraud prevention.

  • Develop scalable sales strategies focused on enterprise customers and recurring revenue.

  • Lead and develop country-level and regional sales teams.

  • Set clear goals, responsibilities, and expectations across the organization.

  • Professionalize sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top commercial talent.

  • Build a high-performance culture based on ownership and accountability.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key enterprise customers and C-level executives.

  • Personally lead complex negotiations, strategic contracts, and high-value opportunities.

  • Drive account growth through cross-selling, upselling, and strategic partnerships.

  • Ensure alignment with Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Partners.

  • Establish a structured and predictable sales operation.

  • Improve pipeline visibility, forecasting, and sales execution.

  • Implement consultative sales methodologies and disciplined CRM practices.

  • Drive commercial efficiency, team productivity, and consistent results.

Required Background and Experience:

  • Proven track record in B2B technology sales, leading regional sales organizations.

  • Strong experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or technology platforms.

  • Experience managing commercial operations across Latin America, ideally including Brazil, Mexico, and Spanish-speaking markets.

  • Experience leading distributed and multicultural teams.

  • Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets and scaling commercial operations.

  • Experience negotiating complex enterprise contracts and engaging with C-level executives.

  • Knowledge of direct sales, channel sales, and strategic partnerships.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, and English.

  • Background in digital identity, cybersecurity, IAM/CIAM, fraud prevention, or authentication.

  • Experience in financial services, telecommunications, or enterprise technology.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies or international organizations.

Executive Competencies:

  • Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business results and drives solutions independently.

  • Hands-on Leadership: Combines strategic vision with direct involvement in closing key opportunities.

  • Executive Presence: Builds credibility and strong relationships with C-level stakeholders.

  • Analytical Discipline: Makes data-driven decisions and establishes clear priorities.

  • Talent Builder: Develops high-performing teams and future commercial leaders.

  • Execution Excellence: Turns strategy into measurable business results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Operates with autonomy, speed, and a strong sense of urgency.

Authority and Scope:

  • Full responsibility for the regional commercial strategy and budget.

  • Authority to lead, develop, and evaluate the sales organization.

  • Ability to define commercial priorities, territories, and resource allocation.

  • Responsibility for negotiations, pricing, and discounts within corporate guidelines.

  • Direct participation in VU’s executive leadership team and strategic planning.

  • Cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Partners.

Definition of Success:

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to drive sustainable regional growth and build an autonomous, scalable, and high-performing commercial organization.

The ultimate goal is to establish executive leadership capable of managing VU’s regional commercial operations independently, developing strategic customer relationships, and reducing the company's operational dependence on the CEO.
